sentences.text: Florida’s inlets are where many charter boats get into trouble.
When a strong ebb current runs out against an onshore wind or swell, waves stack up and break in the entrance.
Before running an inlet, stand off and watch several sets of waves to learn their pattern.
When running in, position the boat on the back of a wave and match its speed, staying there rather than surfing down its face, where you can broach.
If conditions look bad, wait for slack water or the flood, or use another inlet.
Coming home a little late beats not coming home.
